name: matanho-nexus
description: Matanho Nexus: institutional asset management MVP (NestJS API + Next.js portals)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w @nexus/shared" "npm run start:dev -w @nexus/api" "npm run dev -w @nexus/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @nexus/api && npm run build -w @nexus/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @nexus/api && npm run typecheck -w @nexus/web
